title: Econometric Analysis II
instructor: Andreas Hagemann (discussion sections: Brock Rowberry, Bernardo Modenesi)
workloadNotes: Second course of the PhD first-year econometrics sequence (prerequisite: Econ 671; not open to master's students). Problem sets (10%), mid-term exam in-class (40%), comprehensive final exam (50%). Detailed lecture-by-lecture schedule tied to Wooldridge textbook chapters and Bruce Hansen's lecture notes.
textbooks: Wooldridge, Econometric Analysis of Cross-Section and Panel Data, 2nd ed., MIT Press, 2010
van der Vaart, Asymptotic Statistics, Cambridge University Press, 1998 (advanced reference)
